title: Synthetic boards train Siemens' inspection AI at Erlangen
summary:
Synthetic boards train Siemens' inspection AI at Erlangen
Siemens and NVIDIA built AI that prepares circuit board inspection from synthetic images of digital twins, plus an agent that drafts production plans, and are testing both in live production at Erlangen.
SiemensGermany (Siemens Electronics Factory, Erlangen)Industrial machinery and equipmentWith NVIDIAPilot since Jan 2026
tl;drSiemens targets 40% fewer false calls and up to 85% less prep work, with no measured figures out.See the results
On this page
On October 19, 2026, Siemens opened its Electronics Factory in Erlangen to show what it and NVIDIA had built there since January: two AI applications, tested in live production, that move the work of getting a new product onto the line into simulation1. The first uses NVIDIA Cosmos to turn the digital twin of a printed circuit board assembly into photorealistic images, so the plant’s vision systems can be trained and its inspection machines calibrated before a physical prototype exists1, 4. The second is an AI agent that drafts production plans when orders arrive and has each one checked against a digital twin of the whole factory before anything changes on the floor1.
Siemens puts the gains at up to 85% less engineering effort and up to 40% shorter time-to-market for new circuit board assemblies, and up to 20% cost savings from the agent-based planning1. Those are the company’s own ceilings, not measurements. A companion Sieme

title: TÜV SÜD says simulated robot safety checks could start production up to 30% sooner
summary:
TÜV SÜD says simulated robot safety checks could start production up to 30% sooner
TÜV SÜD and Accenture's Physical AI Safety Suite concept checks mobile robot safety in simulation before robots arrive, which could bring production online up to 30% sooner. On-site inspection is still required. Accenture's Sarat Maitin says building safety assessments into planning, rather than leaving them to the end, will bring production online faster.
This story was produced through MarketScale. See how Industrial IoT teams put it to work with AI Visibility (GEO).
Key takeaways
The site inspection stays. The up-to-30% faster startup estimate is tied to moving parts of facility/equipment assessment and certification prep into simulation so evidence can be prepared before hardware arrives.
How much weight simulation evidence carries will depend on new standards for digital twin accuracy, traceability of models and data, and scenario coverage. TÜV SÜD's CEO says ISO 3691-4 alone can't cover all of that.
Safety assessment now belongs in the layout and robot-spec phase: sensor placement can be tested before a prototype exists, and Accenture expects the first large-scale physical AI deployments within 12 months, starting in warehouses.

title: Systems Modelling Language-Driven Digital Twins | Emirates Scholar Center
summary:
Abstract
Using data from various Internet of Things (IoT) sensors attached to any object, system, or process, which is integrated by a specialized model, a digital/virtual blueprint of the physical entity can be attained. Such blueprints that can mirror their real-world counterparts in real-time are known as Digital Twins (DTs). These twins heavily rely on diverse forms of data, and the ones that use the Systems Modelling Language (SysML) to streamline the same are referred to as SysML-driven Digital Twins (SysML-drivenDT’s). Such model based twins are revolutionizing industrial processes such as predictive maintenance and operational optimization in plants through a structured, model-based approach to capturing and simulating complex systems. Here we show the technology behind the functioning of a DT, its vast applications and advantages in the industrial world, and ways to boost efficiency and unlock a massive potential, along with some of the limitations regarding its use. This paper explains the integration of visualization and human interaction tools such as Virtual reality(VR); how SysML-driven DT’s can function in various industries, including robotization of product lines, predictive maintenance, monitoring, cost reduction, and minimization of emissions and waste, and the ways in which it is able to benefit industries, along with limitations such as high initial cost and usage difficulty due to technical complexity. title: MIT Interactive AI Copilot Boosts Structural Load by 39%
summary:
MIT Interactive AI Copilot Boosts Structural Load by 39%
MIT researchers developed an interactive AI copilot that guides structural topology optimization, improving load capacity 39% in 15 seconds.
On this page 3 sections
A research team at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology has created an interactive AI copilot for structural engineering that integrates human judgment directly into topology optimization algorithms. According to findings published in the open-access journal Communications Engineering, the human-in-the-loop framework improved the linear buckling load and physical manufacturability of structural designs by 39 percent while adding only 15 seconds to total computational runtime.
The paper was led by Dat Ha PhD ’26, a recent doctoral graduate in civil and environmental engineering who now works as a structural designer at engineering firm LeMessurier, alongside senior author Josephine Carstensen, an associate professor of civil and environmental engineering at MIT. Co-authors include Ferdous Alam, an assistant professor at Georgia Tech; Markus Buehler, the Jerry McAfee Professor of Engineering; and Faez Ahmed, associate professor of mechanical engineering at MIT.

title: Global weight deep equilibrium attention for numerical simulations on unstructured meshes - Communications Engineering
summary:
Abstract
Graph-based neural networks have emerged as efficient and versatile surrogates for mesh-based numerical simulations. However, achieving high predictive accuracy remains challenging due to over-smoothing, under-reaching during message passing, and disregard for mesh connectivity. To address this, we propose Global Weight Deep Equilibrium Attention (GDEA). GDEA constructs a sparse global weight matrix from mesh connectivity via the direct stiffness method, introducing an inductive bias toward diagonal dominance. We apply the resulting matrix iteratively until convergence, allowing information to propagate globally without adding extra message-passing layers. We formulate the iterative process as a Deep Equilibrium Model (DEQ) to reduce memory consumption, and we use Anderson acceleration to speed convergence. Extensive experiments across multiple numerical simulation datasets, including the newly introduced Deformed ABC dataset with diverse geometries, materials, and boundary conditions, demonstrate that GDEA outperforms other methods on Deformed ABC while remaining competitive on established benchmarks. An accurate surrogate model that can handle diverse design configurations can facilitate efficient early-stage design ex

title: AI and ML for Mechanical Engineers: Courses, Tools, Jobs
summary:
AI and machine learning for mechanical engineers
Where AI is actually used in mechanical work today, the tools, what to learn and in what order, what it pays, and where it fails. Then every Skill-Lync AI and ML course that fits a mechanical engineer, with fees.
By Skill-Lync · Last updated 15 Nov 2026 · Vendor facts checked on their own pages that day
Can a mechanical engineer get into AI?
Yes, and you start closer than you think. Machine learning is curve fitting on a large scale, and a mechanical degree already teaches the calculus, linear algebra and statistics behind it. What you need to add is Python and one honest project on engineering data. Your advantage over a pure software graduate is knowing when a prediction breaks physics.
You don't have to leave mechanical engineering to use AI. Most of the new work sits inside CAE, design and manufacturing teams. It's done by engineers who can both run a simulation and train a model on its results.
Where is AI used in mechanical engineering today?
Five places, in order of how often you will meet them in Indian industry: predicting simulation results without running the solver (surrogate models), generating part shapes from loads and constraints (generative design), predicting machine failure from sensor data, spotting defects in images, and writing the scripts that automate CAD and CAE work.
- Surrogate models for CFD and FEA. Run a few hundred simulations, train a model on the results, and it predicts a new design in seconds instead of hours. Think of it as an experienced engineer's gut feel, written down as maths. It's fast, but only trustworthy close

title: Visual Cipher Bench: Agent Visual Reasoning Test — CASRAI
summary:
On November 12, 2026, researchers from Navers Lab, Einsia.AI, and Tsinghua University released Visual Cipher Bench, a rigorous multimodal benchmark assessing long-horizon visual reasoning in autonomous LLM agents across 40 original puzzle tasks without text guidance. Frontier models achieved an overall accuracy of only 26.7% for the leading configuration, exposing a critical capability gap for academic AI laboratories and evaluation researchers relying on text-centric benchmarks.
Benchmark Architecture: 40 Multi-Step Puzzles and Withheld Text Hints
The research team led by Deyao Hong, Jiayi Jiang, Yuchun Chen, Yixuan Shi, and Huan-ang Gao published their findings in Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning (arXiv:2611.16861). The benchmark codebase and dataset are available on GitHub and the Einsia.AI project platform.
While frontier language-model agents achieve high performance on coding benchmarks like SWE-bench and SWE-Bench Pro, these evaluations rely on explicit text issue descriptions and immediate compiler or test execution feedback. Visual Cipher Bench evaluates whether long-horizon capabilities transfer to visual domains where critical logic is embedded entirely in images and execution feedback is absent.
The benchmark introduces 40 original visual ciphers spanning 67 line drawings, divided into four categories of 10 puzzles each:
- P1: Spatial manipulation and simulation: Multi-step geometric

title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
summary:
Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
Meituan releases the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents. It was trained entirely on Chinese hardware and performs at the level US models like Claude Opus 5 reached a few months ago on coding benchmarks.
The LongCat team at Chinese food delivery company Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, one week after the model's official unveiling. LongCat-2.5 is built for agents that work through long, multi-step tasks autonomously, particularly coding. According to Meituan, it comes close to top Western models on several benchmarks.
LongCat-2.5 is a mixture-of-experts model that activates only a subset of its specialized subnetworks for each token it processes. Out of 1.6 trillion total parameters, roughly 48 billion are active per token. Through the API, the model handles up to one million tokens at once and generates responses up to 128,000 tokens long. It understands text, images, and video, responds in text, and lets users toggle reasoning on and off.
LongCat-2.5 converts images into tokens
LongCat-2.5 builds on its predecessor LongCat-2.0 and adds image understanding. Many multimodal models bolt on a separate image encoder after the fact. Long

title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
summary:
Summary
VisualWebArena 在 2307-WebArena 基础上扩到多模态视觉 web 任务：910 个需要理解图像+文本才能完成的任务，跨 Classifieds / Shopping / Reddit 三个 self-hosted 站点，暴露 text-only LLM agent 与 SOTA 多模态 agent 在 visual grounding 上与人类的显著差距。是 visual web agent 的奠基 benchmark。
Problem & Motivation
既有 web agent benchmark 多为 text-based（依赖 DOM/AXTree），忽略了大量天然需要视觉信息的任务（看商品图选购、按图找帖）。要衡量真正像人一样”看网页”的 agent，需要视觉 grounding 是必要条件的任务集。
Method
构建于 WebArena 的 self-hosted 沙盒基础设施：
- 三站点：Classifieds、Shopping、OneStopMarket、Reddit（复用 WebArena 可复现环境）。
- 910 任务：每个任务要求 agent 准确处理 image-text 混合输入、理解自然语言指令、执行动作；相当比例任务的成功必须依赖视觉理解（如按参考图找相似商品），text-only 无法完成。
- 观察/动作：screenshot + Set-of-Marks + DOM/AXTree，动作沿用 WebArena 的 click/type/scroll 等，用 functional correctness 评测。
Key Results
- 揭示 text-only LLM agent 的能力上限：大量任务因缺视觉信息而无法完成。
- SOTA 多模态 agent（如 GPT-4V）仍与人类有明显 visual grounding gap——能读文本但在视觉定位/细粒度视觉推理上远不及人。
- 成为 visual web agent 路线的标准评测，后续 2606-WebGym 等 pixel-based agent 的重要对照。
Strengths & Weaknesses
亮点：(1) 首个大规模、self-hosted、可复现的多模态 web benchmark，把”视觉是否必要”做成任务设计原则；(2) 复用 WebArena 基建，functional correctness 评测可信；(3) 明确了 visual grounding 是 web agent 的独立瓶颈（与 CUA-Survey grounding 结论一致）。
局限：(1) 只 3 站点、沙盒环境，真实 live 泛化未测（2504-OnlineMind2Web 后来证明沙盒分会崩）；(2) 静态任务集，随模型进步会饱和；(3) 视觉任务占比与难度分布可进一步细化。属 WebAgent-Survey 的观察/grounding 与 benchmark 路线。

title: LongCat-2.5: 1.6T MoE, 48B Active, Native Multimodal
summary:
Meituan releases LongCat-2.5: 1.6T-parameter multimodal MoE with 48B active per token
Meituan's LongCat team has published LongCat-2.5, a native multimodal mixture-of-experts model with 1.6 trillion total parameters and approximately 48 billion activated per token. It targets long-horizon agentic tasks such as codebase development and full-project builds, and ships with W4A4 expert quantization for domestic AI accelerators.
Meituan's LongCat team has released LongCat-2.5, a native multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 1.6 trillion total parameters and approximately 48 billion activated per token. The model page is on Hugging Face under meituan-longcat. It builds on LongCat-2.0 and targets long-horizon agentic tasks: complex codebase development, full-project builds, creative design and 3D tasks.
Architecture and training
LongCat-2.5 builds on LongCat-Next for visual modeling. Native-resolution visual features are converted into discrete tokens and jointly aligned with text in a shared semantic space.
According to Meituan, training combines several elements:
- Agentic RL: real-world engineering tasks and reproducible agent failures, with efficient rollout strategies and safeguards against reward hacking.
- Multi-teacher learning: specialized agent, reasoning and interaction teachers guide the model through full-vocabulary KL distillation and Tree Attention.
- Long-context training efficiency: supernode-aware parallelism, efficient shardi

title: GUI-World: A Video Benchmark and Dataset for Multimodal GUI-oriented Understanding
summary:
Summary
该论文针对现有 MLLM/GUI agent 主要停留在静态网页或移动端、缺乏对动态 GUI 视频与多步交互理解的问题，提出了一个面向多场景 GUI 视频理解的 benchmark 与数据集 GUI-World，并进一步基于 Video LLM 微调得到 GUI-Vid 作为初步改进方案。实验表明，现有 Image LLM 和 Video LLM 在动态 GUI、时序操作和跨窗口场景中普遍表现不佳，而经过面向 GUI 数据增强与微调后，GUI-Vid 在多类 GUI-oriented 任务上有所提升，但距离可靠 GUI agent 仍有明显差距。
Problem & Motivation
这篇论文研究的问题属于 Multimodal GUI understanding / GUI agent / Video-Language Understanding 的交叉领域，核心任务是让模型不仅“看懂”单张界面截图，还能理解 GUI 中随时间变化的内容、用户操作历史以及多步任务过程。这个问题之所以重要，是因为现实中的软件使用、网页浏览、桌面办公、视频编辑、系统设置等场景，几乎都不是静态单帧决策，而是依赖状态转移、弹窗、滚动、页面跳转、多窗口切换和操作序列的。若模型只能理解截图而不能理解时序 GUI，就很难真正成为可用的 GUI agent。
现实价值很直接：一方面，它关系到自动化办公、无障碍辅助、智能教学、软件测试、数字员工等应用；另一方面，它也是通向通用 computer-use agent 的关键基础能力。现有方法的局限至少有三点。第一，大量 GUI benchmark 偏重静态图像理解，只考 icon、OCR、布局或 grounding，忽略动态内容与操作链条，因此高分不代表能完成真实任务。第二，已有工作场景覆盖较窄，通常集中在 web 或 mobile，而真实环境里桌面软件、多窗口、跨应用切换同样常见。第三，Video LLM 在自然视频上训练较多，但 GUI 视频的视觉统计特性与自然视频差异很大：变化稀疏、文字密集、细粒度控件多、关键变化常只发生在局部区域，导致现成 Video LLM 难以直接迁移。
作者提出 GUI-World 的动机总体是合理的：如果想评估和推动 GUI agent，必须先有覆盖动态 GUI、多场景、多任务形式的数据与 benchmark。论文的关键洞察是，GUI 理解的难点不只在“识别界面元素”，更在于“结合时间维度理解状态变化与操作意图”；同时，仅靠现有通用 Video LLM 直接迁移不够，需要专门的数据构建与针对 GUI 场景的训练增强。
Method
从方法上看，这篇论文的核心贡献并不是提出一个全新的复杂模型架构，而是围绕“数据集构建 + benchmark 设计 + 基于 Video LLM 的初步改进”展开。整体框架可以概括为：先采集多种 GUI 场景下的视频数据，再通过关键帧标注与 Human-MLLM collaboration 生成多类型问答任务，形成 GUI-World benchmark；随后用该类 GUI-oriented 视频数据微调一个 Video LLM，得到 GUI-Vid，并通过 progressive enhancement 的思路探索如何提升模型对 GUI 时序内容的理解能力。
关键组件可以分为以下几部分：
-

title: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
summary:
Summary
Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
- 核心: 把 1T-param MoE 文本模型 (Kimi K2) 通过 ~15T mixed vision-text token 的 continual pre-training 升级为原生多模态 agentic 模型；同时引入 Agent Swarm，让 orchestrator 通过 PARL 学习并行调度 frozen 子 agent。
- 方法: (1) Native multimodal pre-training (early fusion + low vision ratio) + zero-vision SFT + 联合多模态 RL；(2) MoonViT-3D 共享图像/视频编码空间；(3) Parallel-Agent RL — 训练 orchestrator + 冻结子 agent，用 critical-steps 作为资源约束。
- 结果: 在 reasoning / coding / vision / agentic benchmark 上对位 Claude Opus 4.5 / GPT-5.2 / Gemini 3 Pro；Agent Swarm 在 BrowseComp 78.4%（超 GPT-5.2 Pro 77.9）、WideSearch 79.0%；wide-search 上比单 agent 快 3-4.5×。
- Sources: paper | website | github
- Rating: 2 - Frontier（open-weight frontier VLM + 首个 system-level RL-trained agent swarm，在 agentic / video benchmark 上 frontier，但方法论以工程整合为主，未达 Foundation 的奠基性）

title: AI Model Predicts Molecular Interactions at Scale
summary:
AI Model Predicts Molecular Interactions at Scale
Trained on 3.2 trillion tokens, Bonbon reveals emergent biological capabilities and discovers novel drug candidates across nine disease targets.
Proteins and small molecules interact in complex ways that researchers can now predict much faster using a newly developed artificial intelligence system called Bonbon. Trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein and ligand sequences, this transformer-based model discovers hidden biological rules without requiring structural 3D coordinates or task-specific supervision during pretraining.
How a Data-Heavy Scaling Regime Unlocks Hidden Interaction Rules
To overcome the inherent information sparsity of paired biological interaction data, the model was built using a parameter-to-token ratio of 1:2,000, which is significantly more data-heavy than standard natural language models. Controlled scaling experiments across six model sizes, ranging from 42 million to 1.6 billion parameters, revealed that pretraining loss decreases smoothly with computing power while complex biological capabilities appear suddenly at the largest scale. As described in the study published on arXiv, the 1.6 billion parameter configuration crosses a critical threshold where high-level interaction features abruptly emerge.
What Are the Three Hierarchical Levels of Resolution Discovered by the Model?

title: Molecular Biologists Develop Breakthrough Method to Save Cells from Toxic Proteins
summary:
Molecular Biologists Develop Breakthrough Method to Save Cells from Toxic Proteins
Abnormal and damaged proteins contribute to many diseases, from Alzheimer’s to cancer. Traditional drugs therefore target and deactivate one specific protein at a time. This works well when a disease is caused by a single type of protein, but complex diseases have many biological actors.
In a recent study published in Science, researchers affiliated with the Department of Molecular & Cell Biology and the Molecular Therapeutics Initiative activated enzymes that promote the removal of multiple harmful proteins. They tested the approach in cellular models of  mitochondrial disorders, including COX deficiency syndrome and Friedreich’s ataxia. Enhancing the cells’ protein quality-control machinery improved mitochondrial function and protected neurons in these disease models.
“Quality control enzymes can protect you from hundreds of misfolded proteins,” said Michael Rapé, a professor of molecular therapeutics. “These are protective pathways that allow cells to survive all sorts of damage.”
The researchers hope the approach, called stimulated protein degradation, will eventually provide new ways to treat complex diseases.
The new strategy expands upon targeted protein degradation, an approach that uses small molecules to activate the cell’s degradation machinery, which uses a molecular tag called ubiquitin to mark specific proteins for destruction. The cell’s trash compactors break the marked proteins into amino acids,

title: Introducing AgentRun: Run smarter agents. Use fewer tokens.
summary:
Introducing AgentRun: Run smarter agents. Use fewer tokens.
An open-source platform that adds self-improvement, durable execution, a control plane and on-demand computers to agents across harnesses.
Agents are great at figuring things out. The problem is they figure out the same things over and over. Give an agent a job it has done a hundred times and it will rediscover the same API, reread the same docs and rebuild the same plan, and you pay for every token of it.
AgentRun fixes that. It's an open-source platform that supercharges your agents. It adds self-improvement, durable execution and a control plane on top of your favorite agent harness: pi (@pidotdev), our default, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or any harness that speaks the Agent Client Protocol. It gives them whatever computer the job needs, too. Your agents get smarter and more fault tolerant, and use fewer tokens with every run. AgentRun handles the plumbing: provider integrations, recovery, run tracking and learning. You don't have to build any of it.

title: Announcing kagent 1.0 GA | Solo.io
summary:
We are super excited to announce v1.0 of kagent, an enterprise-ready distribution of Agent Substrate for running AI agents and Sandboxes on any distribution of Kubernetes (including OpenShift). The project has evolved quite a bit since our original announcement almost two years ago as we've worked with users to design, build, deploy, and operate AI agents in production.
Originally, we focused on "platform / DevOps" style agents built with frameworks like CrewAI, LangChain, ADK, etc configured with a fixed set of tools. We ran agents as a Kubernetes Deployment (Pod replicas), the same way you'd run a microservice, and for that kind of simple agent it worked fine, but that's not what most people are building now. The first pattern we see is the agent harness, a general-purpose loop around a model that gets a goal, a workspace, and some skills/tools/CLIs, and works out the steps on its own (what Anthropic calls agents rather than workflows). Those agents run code a model wrote, keep a workspace around between turns, and spend a lot of their time waiting on a model, tools, or a human.
The other pattern we see is the "tool sandbox". A lot of agent work doesn't need a long-running home at all, it needs somewhere safe to run a tool call (run this script, check this code, transform these files, etc) and hand back the result. Claude Managed Agents is a good example, where Anthropic runs the agent loop and the agent's tool calls can run in sandboxes on your own infrastructure (which kagent supports).

summary:

A New Vision for AI Engineering Agencies
introduces a dual-layer AI engineering framework designed to make autonomous coding agents more context-aware, architecturally disciplined, and capable of recovering from their own mistakes.
The project combines a real-time Node.js Babel Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) tooling engine with 38 domain-expert agent protocols and 13 operational instincts. Its central idea is to move beyond AI agents that simply generate code toward agents that understand software architecture, investigate dependencies, enforce specifications, and validate their work.
Context Compression Could Reduce AI Coding Costs
One of the most significant additions is the Babel AST Context Compactor, which uses PageRank and reverse-caller analysis to reduce codebase context by a claimed 85%–88.5%.
Instead of feeding an AI agent large amounts of source code, the system identifies relevant symbols and their relationships. It also annotates cross-file caller dependencies directly above function signatures.
This could make large software projects considerably easier for AI agents to navigate while reducing token consumption and preserving important architectural context.

apex checkpoint

The project claims recovery times below 100 milliseconds.

title: Inkling 2 Small: Features, Benchmarks and Business Workflows | The AI Firehose Podcast
summary:
01What Inkling 2 Small Is and How It Works
Inkling 2 Small is the second generation of the Inkling model family from a company called Thinking Machines Lab, released on November 5th, 2026. It is built for agentic work, which means it can run long, multi-step tasks like coding, research and document work, not just chat.
The headline number is its score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Inkling 2 Small scored 31. The last version scored 13.
So it jumped from 13 to 31 in one generation.
In this episode, Julian Goldie explains what the model is, what it can do and why it matters for people running a business with AI. The focus is on the kind of work that actually helps a business:
- Agentic, multi-step tasks
- Coding tasks
- Visual understanding
- Long documents
- Autonomous research
The rest of this guide covers how the model is built, its benchmark scores, a real research demo, and three workflows you can copy today.
02Inside the Mixture of Experts Design
The way Inkling 2 Small is built explains a lot about why it works well. It is a mixture of experts model. It has 594 billion total parameters, but only 17 billion are active at any one time.
Think of it like a huge team of 384 specialists. For any one task, only a small group of them gets called in to do the work. You get massive capacity without paying for all of it at once.
That design gives the model a few clear strengths:
- Efficient: only part of the model runs for each task.
- Fast: less work per step means quicker answers.
- Built for complex work: it is designed

title: Plurai raises $13M to make AI agents reliable via self-driving car simulation methods
summary:
Plurai, a startup founded by Ilan Kadar and Elad Levi, has raised $13 million in seed funding to improve the reliability of AI agents using simulation techniques borrowed from autonomous driving. The round was led by Team8, with participation from U&I, Velocity and Mercer.
The co-founders previously worked at Nexar, which develops autonomous driving technology, and Kadar worked with Waymo to simulate and evaluate its end-to-end deep learning driving software. Plurai's approach uses simulations built on synthetic data based on a company's own digital systems to prepare models for difficult edge cases.
The company points to benchmark results showing agents remain unreliable without close supervision: LiveBench 2.0 shows Claude Fable 5.2 and ChatGPT-6 Astra succeeding on 82.9 and 75.6 out of 100 tasks respectively, while an EON test in a simulated corporate environment found Claude Opus 4.8 performing tasks at 76.8% accuracy. Kadar said the pattern mirrors autonomous driving: building a demo is easy, but achieving reliability and cost efficiency is hard. Plurai aims to address failures such as agents ignoring spending policies, struggling to combine data from multiple sets, and losing track during long customer service conversations.

title: Google DeepMind Demonstrates 3D Gothic Cathedral Generation Using Gemini 4 Argon and Blender MCP | TAU-HOME.COM
summary:
Google DeepMind Demonstrates 3D Gothic Cathedral Generation Using Gemini 4 Argon and Blender MCP
Google DeepMind has demonstrated Gemini 4 Argon generating a complete 3D Gothic cathedral from a single 2D image, iteratively refining geometry, textures, and l
On October 23, 2026, Google DeepMind announced a technical demonstration showing its multimodal foundation model, Gemini 4 Argon, generating a complete 3D Gothic cathedral scene from a single 2D concept image. By interfacing with the open-source 3D suite Blender through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the model executed an iterative refinement loop that systematically assembled geometry, applied textures, and balanced lighting inside the @Antigravity execution environment.
Image source: https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2113645959762575623
Unlike generative image models that synthesize multi-view 2D novel views or approximate raw point clouds, this approach positions the language model as an active software operator. Gemini 4 Argon programmatically controls native 3D authoring tools, progressively inspecting and adjusting the virtual scene to build structurally consistent assets.
Blender MCP Architecture and Iterative Refinement

title: Smart Manufacturing IIoT Anomaly Dataset (SMIAD25)
summary:
Smart Manufacturing IIoT Anomaly Dataset (SMIAD25)
Authors/Creators
Description
This dataset represents a large-scale Industrial IoT (IIoT) multivariate time-series collection obtained from smart manufacturing environments operating under Industry 4.0 principles. The data span a continuous period from 17 January 2021 to 30 October 2025, recorded at 15-minute intervals, and capture machine-level operational behavior across multiple production lines, stations, and process stages. Each record corresponds to a unique (timestamp, machine_id) pair and reflects real operational dynamics observed in interconnected industrial systems. TThe acronym of dataset is Smart Manufacturing IIoT Anomaly Dataset (SMIAD25).
The dataset contains heterogeneous feature groups commonly generated in modern manufacturing plants. These include mechanical and vibration-related measurements, acoustic indicators, electrical and drive characteristics, thermal and environmental readings, and process-level operational metrics. In addition, inspection- and vision-derived quality indicators are included to represent downstream quality assessment and surface inspection activities. Temporal evolution is characterized through change-based features, rolling statistics, and trend descriptors that reflect gradual degradation and long-term behavioral shifts.

title: Understanding CSS Glassmorphism and Backdrop Filters
summary:
Understanding CSS Glassmorphism and Backdrop Filters
Frosted glass UI elements dominate modern web design. Here is the technical breakdown of how CSS backdrop-filter works and its performance implications.
The Rise of the Frosted Web
Deriving inspiration directly from the physical property of brushed glass, Glassmorphism is a UI paradigm heavily utilized by companies like Apple (visionOS, macOS) and Microsoft (Fluent Design) to establish a sense of multi-dimensional hierarchy. By partially obscuring complex background textures underneath a blurred plane, the interface feels dynamic, breathable, and innately premium.
The CSS Under the Hood
In legacy frontend iterations, creating frosted glass required immense manual trickery—layering duplicated background images with hard-coded blur scales. In 2026, modern browser engines cleanly expose this visual manipulation via a single line of code:
backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(180%);
This command inherently instructs the graphics processing unit (GPU) of the user's device to hook into whatever dynamic pixel data rests directly "behind" the target HTML div node and apply expensive gaussian blurs in real-time before painting the frame.
Performance and Fallbacks
Because `backdrop-filter` triggers aggressive GPU repaints, excessively nesting glass elements over moving video tags or complex CSS animations can cause catastrophic frame-drops (jank) on lower-end mobile hardware.

title: Yelp AI 助手融合原生 UI 与服务端驱动 UI
summary:
Yelp 为其 AI 助手采用了混合用户界面架构，将原生移动控件与服务器驱动的对话渲染相结合，实现跨平台界面的快速迭代。该方案基于 Yelp 的 CHAOS 框架（全称 Content Hosting Architecture with Optimization Strategies，带优化策略的内容托管架构）渲染对话内容，导航栏与消息输入框则保留原生实现。
Yelp 助手于 2024 年在 iOS 上推出，帮助用户向本地服务从业者提交服务需求。此后，它逐步扩展至查询商户相关信息，并可完成预订、预约、点餐等操作。
CHAOS 支持 Web、iOS 和 Android。在服务器驱动 UI 架构中，由后端定义客户端显示的内容以及如何响应交互，因此无需发布新的移动应用版本即可让界面变更触达用户。
Yelp 服务技术负责人 Daniel Andrade Groppe 强调：
我们现有的 CHAOS 框架缺少助手所需的一些能力，包括文本输入字段和网络请求。扩展框架会延迟交付，因此我们采用了混合方法：保持导航和消息输入为原生实现，同时使用 CHAOS 渲染对话区域。
这套实现将视图配置和对话数据分离。聊天会话启动时，客户端拉取 CHAOS 配置并初始化消息事件数据集。后续消息事件直接更新现有视图，无需重新拉取配置。事件类型包含持久化的用户消息和机器人消息、临时输入指示器和快速回复，以及打开目标页面的链接。后端还可以发送指令来控制界面。例如，当项目请求完成时，它可以返回一条消息、一个查看匹配的链接，以及一个禁用聊天输入的动作。这种事件驱动设计将渲染与对话逻辑分离开。
Airbnb 通过其 Ghost Platform 公开过类似的思路，该平台在 Web 和移动客户端上使用服务器定义的 UI。这两种方案都允许团队更新界面展示效果时不必每次改动都打包发布新版本客户端。Yelp 将该模型应用于对话界面，同时保留原生控件，在客户端维护消息状态与交互处理。
客户端显示已提交的消息和输入指示器，禁用输入，并向后端发送请求。收到响应后，显示回复和快速回复，并重新启用输入。恢复错误会自动重试，不可恢复的故障则禁用输入并提示用户稍后重试。
Yelp 工程师指出，该架构也带来协同复杂度，工程师需要时间来同时理解助手和 CHAOS，而且同一套逻辑在不同平台上仍可能表现不一样。将视图配置与对话数据分离实现了独立的功能开发。该架构还支持复用 Android 助手来启动 Biz Ask Anything 试点项目。Yelp 表示，这项工作为其下一代助手奠定了基础，新版助手现在可以将商家信息与用户可执行的操作连接起来。
